name: Moudud Ahmed
contribution: Moudud Ahmed was a lawyer and politician who served in the Ershad government before resigning at the decisive end of the regime.
context: His resignation in December 1990 helped clear the constitutional route for Chief Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed to lead the interim transition.
impact: The episode shows how an institutional break inside the ruling order helped convert mass opposition into a transfer of power.
seoDescription: Profile of Moudud Ahmed, tracing links to the 1990 Mass Uprising, anti-Ershad movement, and democratic transition in Bangladesh.
shortAnswer: Moudud Ahmed is linked to the 1990 Mass Uprising in this timeline as Constitutional Intermediary.

faq.question: How is Moudud Ahmed connected to the 1990 Mass Uprising?
faq.answer: Moudud Ahmed is connected to the anti-Ershad democratic movement as Constitutional Intermediary. At the end of the regime, his resignation cleared the final procedural path for power to pass to Shahabuddin Ahmed.
